name: 78840 · Del Rio, TX
findings: ZIP 78840 (Del Rio) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78840 (Del Rio) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78840 (Del Rio) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
